Lockout/Tagout (Loto) Procedures

ENERGY SOURCES:

☐ Electrical

☐ Mechanical

☐ Hydraulic

☐ Pneumatic

☐ Chemical

☐ Thermal

☐ Stored energy (springs, capacitors, gravity)

LOTO PROCEDURE STEPS:

1. Notify affected employees

2. Shut down equipment using normal procedure

3. Isolate energy sources (disconnect, valve, etc.)

4. Apply lock and tag

5. Release stored energy

6. Verify isolation - test equipment

7. Perform service/maintenance

8. Remove tools, guards, etc.

9. Notify affected employees

10. Remove lock and tag

11. Restore energy and test

LOTO EQUIPMENT INVENTORY:

☐ Locks (each employee has personal lock)

☐ Tags (durable, attached)

☐ Lock hasps (for multiple locks)

☐ LOTO procedure written for each equipment

SPILL PROCEDURE:

1. Assess risk - evacuate if necessary

2. Don appropriate PPE

3. Contain spill (absorbents, dikes)

5. Clean up using proper tools

6. Place waste in labeled container

7. Dispose of waste properly

8. Report spill to supervisor

9. Restock spill kit

• Wear appropriate PPE

Working With Students Present

When maintenance must occur during school hours:

BEFORE WORK BEGINS:

☐ Notify principal/administration

☐ Notify teachers in affected areas

☐ Post warning signs at all access points

☐ Set up barricades/tape to restrict access

☐ Secure tools and materials when not in use

☐ Store chemicals in locked area

DURING WORK:

☐ Maintain barriers throughout work

☐ Never leave hazards unguarded

☐ Keep work area clean - no trip hazards

☐ Control dust (wet methods, vacuums, barriers)

☐ Control noise - schedule loud work when students not present if possible

☐ Do not allow students in work area

☐ Be aware of students nearby

☐ Communicate with staff about any changes

AFTER WORK:

☐ Clean up thoroughly

☐ Remove all barriers/signs when area is safe

☐ Inspect area for hazards before reopening

☐ Notify staff area is safe to use

SPECIAL CONSIDERATIONS:

☐ Asbestos/lead work requires special procedures - cannot be done with students present

☐ Major renovations should be scheduled during breaks

☐ Pest control applications require notification and may require relocation
